content:
The Indian Air Force has released the Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 Admit Card 2026.

The examination is scheduled for 22 and 23 September 2026. Download the admit card from the official portal and verify the examination centre and reporting instructions.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 06/07/2026
  • Last date to apply: 26/07/2026
  • Exam city available: 11/09/2026
  • Exam date: 22-23/09/2026
  • Admit card available: 19/09/2026
